pain: Native advertising — an article, paid for by a brand, written and designed in the voice of the newspaper or magazine that runs it. Readers finish it the way they finish any other story. Display ads get skipped; native earns its way in.
ctaMeta: First time running native? That's who this is for. Talk to the desk before you decide anything.
sideBody: Reader engagement on a well-made native article vs. a display ad in the same publication. Print issues sit on coffee tables for weeks; the digital version is archived in the title.
